X F R A N G E
A D R I v I n G F O R C E I n D E S I G n
A driving force in design, engineering and innovation, the XF harnesses
the breathtaking power of a sports car to the sublime pleasure of a world
class luxury sedan. Whatever choice of model or options each individual
customer selects, every XF epitomizes Jaguar’s pursuit of excellence and
attention to detail. The following section provides in-depth descriptions
and specifications of the entire XF range, with each model’s main features
and available options. It also gives a complete selection of exciting
exterior finishes and premium interior trims, which offer further
opportunities to make an XF even more individual and personal.

standards in all areas of business activity.
